name: @noticed/cli
stderr:
Usage: noticed [options] [command]

Developer intelligence — search your network, trace connections, discover paths

Options:
  -v, --version             Display the current version
  --api-url <url>           Override NOTICED_API_URL
  --api-key <key>           Override NOTICED_API_KEY
  -h, --help                display help for command

Commands:
  search [options] <query>  Search your developer network for people, companies,
                            skills, or topics
  path [options] [target]   Find the shortest connection path to a person
  mcp [options]             Bridge stdio clients to the canonical noticed MCP
  config [options]          Show or set configuration
  completion [shell]        Generate shell completion script (bash, zsh, fish)
  help [command]            display help for command
